data.indexFullNameEn: CSI Semiconductor Material & Equipment Thematic Index
data.indexCnDesc: 中证半导体材料设备主题指数选取40只业务涉及半导体材料和半导体设备等领域的上市公司证券作为指数样本，反映半导体材料和设备上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI Semiconductor Material & Equipment Thematic Index is composed of 40 listed securities whose business involves in semiconductor materials and equipment as constituents. The index is to measure the performance of semiconductor materials and equipment industry.
